headline: GNRC Q2 Deep Dive: Data Center Backlog Fuels Commercial Segment Expansion
summary: Power generation products company Generac (NYSE:GNRC) missed Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q2 CY2026, but sales rose 10.6% year on year to $1.17 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $2.91 per share was 44.6% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
